response.justification: Strong senior individual contributor with 15+ years of software development and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth (built a D test runner, an assertion library, Selenium curricula, CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure, and MCP/agent tooling). However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management — no manager titles, no mention of direct reports, hiring, performance reviews, or one-on-ones — which is the explicit 2-year minimum and the core of this Level II Manager role. Technical leadership is implied by Staff titles and founding GISCollective, but is not described in organizational terms. Worth a screening call to probe for unstated leadership/mentoring scope, but the profile currently reads as an IC track rather than a management track.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer tooling and test infrastructure experience (test runners, assertion libs, CI/CD, DevOps)
15+ years of broad engineering across web, mobile (iOS/tvOS), embedded, and high-throughput backends
Demonstrated knowledge sharing and mentoring via workshops, courses, dojos, and open-source projects
concerns: No documented people management experience or direct reports (misses 2-year minimum)
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform exposure is dated and limited; no large mobile-ecosystem build system experience

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
